hero.headline: We Have Liftoff.
hero.subheadline: Mars Cafe is officially open. Retro booths, cosmic brews, and opening week specials you won't want to miss.

offers.heading: Opening Week Specials
offers.subheading: Celebrate with us — these offers are only available through October 5th.

items.title: Buy 1 Get 1 Free
items.desc: All coffees, all day, every day during opening week. Bring your co-pilot.

items.title: Free Pastry
items.desc: The first 50 guests each day get a complimentary pastry. First come, first served.

items.title: Loyalty Card
items.desc: Every new visitor gets a loyalty card. Your 10th coffee is on us — always.

ended.headline: The Launch Party Is Over
ended.message: Our Grand Opening week has wrapped up — but Mars Cafe is open every day. Come find your orbit anytime.

comingSoon.headline: Prepare for Liftoff
comingSoon.message: Mars Cafe is launching on September 24th. Opening week specials await.
